title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version keeps the curated reader-facing working surface and adds the RA28 Paper 02 Greek nu restoration/source-audit correction package after the RA25-RA27 symbol-audit tranches.

Current reader files. The main cumulative readers and standalone English paper PDFs remain the reader-facing surface. RA25, RA26, RA27, and RA28 are correction/audit tranches for the German/source branch of Paper 02, not full multilingual propagation packages.

Latest correction package. Adds N_SYM_RA28_nu_restore_20260612.zip. The package supersedes the RA13-RA27 Latin-v interpretation in Paper 02 where the Crelle source defines the form letter as Greek nu. It restores the German branch to Greek \nu while preserving genuine polar Latin v contexts, and includes restored German TeX/PDF, evidence crops, unified diff, nu/v inventory, revert ledgers, recursive scan disposition, audit PDF, render checks, checksums, and package manifest. Do not propagate the earlier RA13-RA27 \nu -> v ledgers into EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. The files are useful working drafts, translation drafts, and source-audit correction packets; subtle formula errors, scan-reading errors, apparatus drift, and cross-language synchronization errors may remain. Verify important equations, tables, theorem statements, and unusual notation against the source witnesses before citation-critical use.

Known open items. Multilingual propagation of the RA28 correction remains open. Next source-critical work resumes Paper 02 from printed p84, pp85-90, and table plates. Full symbol-level source audit remains open beyond Paper 01 and the current Paper 02 tranches.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
